capture_mode: deterministic hidden in-app replay through canvas_input
cursor_cue: A synthetic pointer ring is labeled DRAW while drawing, SELECT while editing, and ORBIT during camera navigation; persistent text discloses synthetic input and no pressure data.

encoding.gif: Accelerated six-second preview of the same 60 replay checkpoints; plays once without a loop extension. Use the captioned MP4 master for normal-speed instruction.
encoding.mp4: Captured full-viewport RGBA frames; Blender H.264 fallback; 10 fps; repeated frame holds preserve the 12s duration.
encoding.poster: Selected full-resolution action frame encoded as PNG.

input_note: This deterministic tutorial uses synthetic pressure=None pointer samples. Drawing, selection, transform, undo/redo, native save, and native reopen use production app handlers. MP4 checkpoints are held to make the action steps readable; no tablet pressure or latency was measured.
license_or_provenance: Original procedural Sketch3D scene with editable planar fills, graphite linework, window-light fills, a ground shadow, and saved wall, roof, and chimney guides.

poster.alt: A clear two-story dusk house with amber windows, a cool shaded side, a ground shadow, and a graphite detail.

outputs.gif_preview: Accelerated 6-second preview; use the MP4 and timed VTT for normal-speed playback.

review.notes: Reviewed the 12-second MP4 at representative action checkpoints and all 60 GIF checkpoints in sequence. Captions match the draw, select/move, orbit, save/reopen, and artwork-only sections. The poster and full-resolution still show the intended colors; the GIF plays once with a deliberate artwork-only ending. The README preview and links were checked, and no private content is visible.

shot_steps: Draw a graphite accent on the saved front-wall guide through production canvas input.
Save and reopen the edited native scene through production document handlers, then orbit to reveal its depth.
Export a full-resolution still through the artwork image exporter and finish in artwork-only view.
